title: Classification of Muscle Invasive Bladder Cancer to Predict Prognosis of Patients Treated with Immunotherapy.
summary: Machine-learning analysis of muscle-invasive bladder-cancer patient data identified features associated with immunotherapy prognosis; this retrospective association does not establish treatment benefit.
ai_technology: Machine-learning analysis applies the stated model to the paper’s medicine dataset and evaluates the reported outcome.
